\section{附录 D. 完整公式与算法汇编}
本附录用于防止公式、推导和算法在总册中被压缩成名称列表。内容按物理对象、线性代数、MG、分布式实现、缓存、性能和 508 历史算法分层。不同路径的归一化、storage 和停止条件分别标明。

\section{D.1 连续 QCD、格点截断与物理目标}
连续欧氏 QCD 拉氏量写为

\begin{displaymath}
\mathcal L_{\mathrm{QCD}} = \bar\psi_i\left(i\gamma_\mu D^\mu_{ij}-m\delta_{ij}\right)\psi_j -\frac14F^a_{\mu\nu}F^{a}_{\mu\nu},
\end{displaymath}

其中 \pycode{D\_mu = partial\_mu - i g A\_mu\textasciicircum{}a T\textasciicircum{}a}，\pycode{T\textasciicircum{}a} 为颜色生成元。格点方法将连续时空替换为

\begin{displaymath}
x_\mu=n_\mu a,\qquad n_\mu=0,\ldots,L_\mu-1.
\end{displaymath}

格距和有限体积分别提供紫外、红外截断：

\begin{displaymath}
\Lambda_{\mathrm{UV}}\sim\frac{\pi}{a}, \qquad \Lambda_{\mathrm{IR}}\sim\frac{2\pi}{L}.
\end{displaymath}

\subsection{D.1.1 准 PDF}
沿 \pycode{z} 方向、核子动量 \pycode{P\_z} 的准 PDF 定义为

\begin{displaymath}
\widetilde f(x,P_z,1/a) = \int\frac{dz}{4\pi}e^{ixzP_z} \left\langle P\left| \bar\psi(z)\gamma_t U(z,0)\psi(0) \right|P\right\rangle,
\end{displaymath}

其中 \pycode{U(z,0)} 是规范链接。有限 \pycode{a} 计算得到 quasi-PDF，再通过大动量/连续极限外推。MG/BiCGStab 的任务是得到该矩阵元所需的夸克传播子，不直接完成匹配核或重整化。

\subsection{D.1.2 两点关联函数与 Wick 收缩}
介子两点函数可写为

\begin{displaymath}
C_2(t,t_0)= \left\langle \bar\psi(x,t)\Gamma\psi(x,t) \bar\psi(y,t_0)\Gamma'\psi(y,t_0) \right\rangle.
\end{displaymath}

对单 flavor 费米子做 Wick 收缩后，代表性项为

\begin{displaymath}
C_2(t,t_0) =-\gamma_5 S_q(x,y)\gamma_5 S_q(y,x),
\end{displaymath}

其中

\begin{displaymath}
S_q=D_q^{-1}
\end{displaymath}

是 quark propagator。求解传播子等价于对多个 right-hand side 反复求解 \pycode{D\_q x=b}。

\section{D.2 格点规范场、plaquette 与作用量}
\subsection{D.2.1 规范链接}
\pycode{U\_mu(x) in SU(3)} 连接 \pycode{x} 与 \pycode{x+mu\_hat}。协变平移为

\begin{displaymath}
T_{+\mu}\psi(x)=U_\mu(x)\psi(x+\hat\mu), \qquad T_{-\mu}\psi(x)=U_\mu^\dagger(x-\hat\mu)\psi(x-\hat\mu).
\end{displaymath}

局部规范变换为

\begin{displaymath}
U_\mu(x)\to G(x)U_\mu(x)G^\dagger(x+\hat\mu), \qquad \psi(x)\to G(x)\psi(x).
\end{displaymath}

协变性要求

\begin{displaymath}
D[U^G]\psi^G=G\,D[U]\psi.
\end{displaymath}

\subsection{D.2.2 Plaquette 与 Clover 场强}
有向 plaquette 为

\begin{displaymath}
P_{\mu\nu}(x)= U_\mu(x)U_\nu(x+\hat\mu) U^\dagger_\mu(x+\hat\nu)U^\dagger_\nu(x).
\end{displaymath}

四叶 Clover 和为

\begin{displaymath}
Q_{\mu\nu} =P_{\mu\nu}+P_{\nu,-\mu}+P_{-\mu,-\nu}+P_{-\nu,\mu}.
\end{displaymath}

反 Hermitian 场强项为

\begin{displaymath}
C_{\mu\nu}=Q_{\mu\nu}-Q^\dagger_{\mu\nu}.
\end{displaymath}

代码常用形式可写为

\begin{displaymath}
\sigma_{\mu\nu}F_{\mu\nu} = 2\gamma_\mu\gamma_\nu \frac14\sum_P\frac12(P-P^\dagger),
\end{displaymath}

其中的 gamma 和 plaquette 顺序必须与源码 convention 一致。

\subsection{D.2.3 Wilson hopping kernel}
取 \pycode{r=1}：

\begin{displaymath}
(H\psi)_x= \sum_{\mu=0}^3 \left[ (1-\gamma_\mu)U_{\mu,x}\psi_{x+\hat\mu} +(1+\gamma_\mu)U^\dagger_{\mu,x-\hat\mu}\psi_{x-\hat\mu} \right].
\end{displaymath}

算子与作用量：

\begin{displaymath}
D_W=(m_0+4)I-\frac12H, \qquad S_W=\sum_x\bar\psi_xD_W\psi_x.
\end{displaymath}

hopping 参数：

\begin{displaymath}
\kappa=\frac{1}{2m_0+8}, \qquad \frac{1}{2\kappa}=m_0+4.
\end{displaymath}

另一种等价形式：

\begin{displaymath}
D_W=\frac{1}{2\kappa}(I-\kappa H).
\end{displaymath}

预条件归一化：

\begin{displaymath}
D_{\mathrm{pc}}=I-\frac{\kappa}{u_0}H, \qquad D_W=(m_0+4)D_{\mathrm{pc}}.
\end{displaymath}

当前 C++ 生产路径使用 \pycode{u0=1}。原始 Dslash 接口返回 \pycode{H}，不能把 \pycode{I-kappa H} 和 \pycode{H} 在同一比较中混用。

\subsection{D.2.4 Clover onsite block}
Clover 项可写为

\begin{displaymath}
D_C=D_W+c_{\mathrm{SW}}\frac{i}{4} \sum_{\mu<\nu}\sigma_{\mu\nu}F_{\mu\nu}, \qquad \sigma_{\mu\nu}=\frac12[\gamma_\mu,\gamma_\nu].
\end{displaymath}

实现归一化：

\begin{displaymath}
T_p=-\frac{\kappa c_{\mathrm{sw}}}{8u_0} \sum_{\mu<\nu}\gamma_\mu\gamma_\nu C_{\mu\nu}, \qquad A_p=I_p+T_p.
\end{displaymath}

当前有效 \pycode{c\_sw=1}。Clover 项只增加 onsite block，不改变 hopping support。

\section{D.3 Wilson/Clover 的谱、极限与误差}
自由场 \pycode{U=1} 时，Fourier 模满足

\begin{displaymath}
D_W(p)=M(p)I+i\sum_\mu\gamma_\mu\sin p_\mu,
\end{displaymath}

其中

\begin{displaymath}
M(p)=m_0+\sum_\mu(1-\cos p_\mu).
\end{displaymath}

因此

\begin{displaymath}
D_W^\dagger(p)D_W(p) = \left[ M(p)^2+\sum_\mu\sin^2p_\mu \right]I.
\end{displaymath}

该式给出三项回归：

\begin{center}\small
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{2pt}
\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.300\textwidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.300\textwidth}@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{模} & \textbf{检查} \\
\midrule\endhead
\pycode{p=0} & 质量项 \pycode{M(0)=m0} \\
\pycode{p->-p} & gamma 项符号反对称 \\
\pycode{p\_mu≈pi} & Wilson 项抬高 doubler \\
\bottomrule\end{longtable}
\end{center}
Wilson/Clover 满足

\begin{displaymath}
D^\dagger=\gamma_5D\gamma_5.
\end{displaymath}

因此 \pycode{gamma5*D} 可作为 Hermitian 相关算子，但 \pycode{D} 本身不是 Hermitian。

离散误差至少包含

\begin{displaymath}
e_{\mathrm{total}} \lesssim e_{\mathrm{discrete}} +e_{\mathrm{setup}} +e_{\mathrm{alg}} +e_{\mathrm{round}} +e_{\mathrm{comm}}.
\end{displaymath}

减小 solver tolerance 只控制 \pycode{e\_alg}，不能修复 gamma、Clover 或 gauge link 约定。

\section{D.4 奇偶 Schur、MATPC 与重建}
\subsection{D.4.1 Full block system}
按 parity 排列：

\begin{displaymath}
D= \begin{pmatrix} A_p&D_{pq}\\ D_{qp}&A_q \end{pmatrix}, \qquad b= \begin{pmatrix} b_p\\ b_q \end{pmatrix}.
\end{displaymath}

Schur complement：

\begin{displaymath}
S_p=A_p-D_{pq}A_q^{-1}D_{qp}.
\end{displaymath}

若 \pycode{D=A-kappa H}，则

\begin{displaymath}
S_p=A_p-\kappa^2H_{pq}A_q^{-1}H_{qp}.
\end{displaymath}

对称归一化 MATPC：

\begin{displaymath}
M_p=A_p^{-1}S_p =I-\kappa^2A_p^{-1}H_{pq}A_q^{-1}H_{qp}.
\end{displaymath}

\subsection{D.4.2 Prepare 与 reconstruct}
通用 \pycode{D} block 写法：

\begin{displaymath}
b_p^{\mathrm{prep}} =A_p^{-1}\left(b_p-D_{pq}A_q^{-1}b_q\right),
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
x_q=A_q^{-1}(b_q-D_{qp}x_p).
\end{displaymath}

若使用 \pycode{D=A-kappa H}，符号写成

\begin{displaymath}
b_p^{PC} =A_p^{-1}\left(b_p+\kappa H_{pq}A_q^{-1}b_q\right),
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
x_q=A_q^{-1}\left(b_q+\kappa H_{qp}x_p\right).
\end{displaymath}

两种写法只差 off-diagonal 符号和 kappa 是否被吸收。

\subsection{D.4.3 Schur 求解算法}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.1: parity Schur solve
Input:
  full b=(b_p,b_q)
  onsite blocks A_p, A_q
  off-diagonal hopping D_pq, D_qp
  tolerance tau and full residual gate eta

1. solve A_q y_q = b_q
2. b_p^S = b_p - D_pq y_q
3. solve S_p x_p = b_p^S with selected Krylov method
4. reconstruct x_q = A_q^{-1}(b_q - D_qp x_p)
5. form x=(x_p,x_q)
6. compute r_true=b-D x
7. accept only if
      ||r_true||/||b|| <= eta
8. return x, r_true, iterations, breakdown status
\end{Verbatim}
\subsection{D.4.4 残差审计恒等式}
若

\begin{displaymath}
r=b-Dx,
\end{displaymath}

则精确解满足

\begin{displaymath}
x=D^{-1}b.
\end{displaymath}

残差和误差满足

\begin{displaymath}
\frac{\| x-x_\star\|}{\| x_\star\|} \le \kappa_2(D) \frac{\| r\|}{\| b\|},
\end{displaymath}

因此残差小不总是等价于误差小，尤其条件数很大时。Schur residual、Arnoldi estimate 和 GCR iterated residual 均为不同量，必须由 full \pycode{r\_true} 最终验收。

\section{D.5 Krylov 方法完整递推}
\subsection{D.5.1 CG}
适用条件是 \pycode{A} Hermitian positive definite。

\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.2: preconditioned CG
Input: A, b, x0, preconditioner M^-1, tolerance tau
r0 = b - A x0
z0 = M^-1 r0
p0 = z0
rho0 = <r0,z0>
for k = 0,1,...:
    v = A p_k
    denom = <p_k,v>
    if denom <= 0 or nonfinite(denom): BREAKDOWN
    alpha = rho_k / denom
    x_{k+1} = x_k + alpha p_k
    r_{k+1} = r_k - alpha v
    if ||r_{k+1}|| <= tau ||b||:
        r_true = b - A x_{k+1}
        return if r_true gate passes
    z_{k+1} = M^-1 r_{k+1}
    rho_{k+1} = <r_{k+1},z_{k+1}>
    beta = rho_{k+1} / rho_k
    p_{k+1} = z_{k+1} + beta p_k
    rho_k = rho_{k+1}
\end{Verbatim}
对 \pycode{D\textasciicircum{}dagger D} 使用 CG 时，系统条件数从 \pycode{kappa\_2(D)} 变为 \pycode{kappa\_2(D)\textasciicircum{}2}。这可以避免非 SPD 问题，却可能显著增加迭代。

\subsection{D.5.2 多移位 CG}
同时求解

\begin{displaymath}
(A+\sigma_jI)x^{(j)}=b,\qquad j=0,\ldots,J-1.
\end{displaymath}

当前源码要求 \pycode{shifts} 严格升序，最低移位 \pycode{sigma\_0} 为主链。一次主链 matvec 被所有移位共享，其余链按照 Jegerlehner/QUDA 的 \pycode{zeta/alpha} 递推同步下降。

\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.3: PyQCU multi-shift CG
Input:
  A, b
  strictly increasing shifts sigma_0 < ... < sigma_{J-1}
  x_j = 0 for all shifts
r = b
p_0 = r
zeta_j = zeta_old_j = 1
beta_j = 0
alpha_j = 1
active_j = true
r2 = <r,r>

for k = 0,1,...:
    Ap = A p_0
    Ap = Ap + sigma_0 p_0
    pAp = <p_0,Ap>
    if nonfinite(pAp) or |pAp| <= floor: BREAKDOWN

    alpha_old_0 = alpha_0
    alpha_0 = r2 / pAp

    for j = 1,...,J-1:
        if not active_j: continue
        c0 = zeta_j*zeta_old_j*alpha_old_0
        c1 = alpha_0*beta_0*(zeta_old_j-zeta_j)
        c2 = zeta_old_j*alpha_old_0*
             (1+(sigma_j-sigma_0)*alpha_0)
        zeta_old_j = zeta_j
        denom = c1+c2
        zeta_j = c0/denom                 # guard zero/nonfinite
        alpha_j = alpha_0*zeta_j/zeta_old_j

    r2_old = r2
    r = r-alpha_0*Ap
    r2 = <r,r>
    beta_0 = r2/r2_old

    x_0 = x_0+alpha_0*p_0
    p_0 = r+beta_0*p_0

    for j = 1,...,J-1:
        if not active_j: continue
        beta_j = beta_0*zeta_j*alpha_j/
                 (zeta_old_j*alpha_0)
        x_j = x_j+alpha_j*p_j
        p_j = zeta_j*r+beta_j*p_j
        estimate_j = zeta_j*zeta_j*r2
        if estimate_j < stop_j:
            active_j = false
\end{Verbatim}
源码实现还有两项关键保护：

\begin{enumerate}
\item \pycode{zeta} 若非有限或超过 \pycode{1e15}，该移位冻结，避免 c64 精度地板下递推爆炸。

\item 主链的 \pycode{sigma\_0 p\_0} 直接折叠进共享的 \pycode{Ap}，主残差 \pycode{r} 因而保持与 (A+sigma0)x 对应；源码明确禁止周期性 \pycode{r} 替换，因为会破坏 CG 共轭性。

\end{enumerate}
适用条件：基准算子 \pycode{A} Hermitian positive definite，移位为标量 \pycode{sigma\_j I}。源码锚点为 \pycode{pyqcu/solver/\_multishift\_cg.py}。

\subsection{D.5.3 BiCG}
BiCG 同时维护 \pycode{A} 和 \pycode{A\textasciicircum{}dagger} 的 Krylov sequence：

\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.4: BiCG
r = b - A x
r_tilde = shadow residual
p = r
p_tilde = r_tilde
for k = 0,1,...:
    rho = <r_tilde,r>
    if rho = 0 or nonfinite: BREAKDOWN
    v = A p
    denom = <p_tilde,v>
    if denom = 0 or nonfinite: BREAKDOWN
    alpha = rho/denom
    x = x + alpha p
    r_new = r - alpha v
    r_tilde_new = r_tilde - alpha A^dagger p_tilde
    rho_new = <r_tilde_new,r_new>
    beta = rho_new/rho
    p = r_new + beta p
    p_tilde = r_tilde_new + beta p_tilde
    r = r_new
    r_tilde = r_tilde_new
\end{Verbatim}
其内存较低，但需要额外 dagger matvec，且 shadow breakdown 可能在非正规矩阵上发生。

\subsection{D.5.4 CGS}
CGS 去掉显式 shadow vector，并让 residual polynomial 以平方形式递推：

\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.5: preconditioned CGS
r = b - A x
r_tilde = choose_shadow(r)
rho_old = 1; u = 0; p = 0; q = 0
for k = 0,1,...:
    rho = <r_tilde,r>
    if rho == 0 or nonfinite: BREAKDOWN
    if k == 0:
        u = r
        p = u
    else:
        beta = rho/rho_old
        u = r + beta q
        p = u + beta(q + beta p)
    p_hat = M^-1 p
    v = A p_hat
    denom = <r_tilde,v>
    if denom == 0 or nonfinite: BREAKDOWN
    alpha = rho/denom
    q = u - alpha v
    u_hat = M^-1 (u+q)
    x = x + alpha u_hat
    r = r - alpha A u_hat
    rho_old = rho
\end{Verbatim}
该递推减少 shadow storage，但 residual polynomial 的平方会放大非正规矩阵上的舍入误差。

\subsection{D.5.5 BiCGStab}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.6: BiCGStab with guarded scalars
Input:
  A, b, explicit x0
  tolerance tau, max_iter, reliable_period
r = b - A x0
r_shadow = copy(r)
p = 0
v = 0
rho_old = alpha = omega = 1

for k = 0,1,...,max_iter-1:
    rho = <r_shadow,r>
    if nonfinite(rho) or |rho| <= breakdown_floor: BREAKDOWN
    beta = (rho/rho_old) * (alpha/omega)
    p = r + beta*(p - omega*v)

    v = A p

    denom = <r_shadow,v>
    if nonfinite(denom) or |denom| <= breakdown_floor: BREAKDOWN
    alpha = rho/denom
    s = r - alpha*v

    if ||s|| <= tau ||b||:
        x = x + alpha*p
        r_true = b - A x
        if true_residual_gate(r_true): return x

    t = A s
    tt = <t,t>
    if nonfinite(tt) or real(tt) <= breakdown_floor: BREAKDOWN
    omega = <t,s>/tt
    if nonfinite(omega) or |omega| <= breakdown_floor: BREAKDOWN

    x = x + alpha*p + omega*s
    r = s - omega*t

    if reliable_update_due(k,reliable_period):
        r = b - A x

    if ||r|| <= tau ||b||:
        r_true = b - A x
        if true_residual_gate(r_true): return x

    rho_old = rho
\end{Verbatim}
\pycode{breakdown\_floor} 必须结合 dtype、向量范数和全局归约精度设置，不能用一个与格点规模无关的常数。

\subsection{D.5.6 Arnoldi、GMRES 与 FGMRES}
Arnoldi 关系：

\begin{displaymath}
AV_m=V_{m+1}\bar H_m, \qquad \bar H_m\in\mathbb C^{(m+1)\times m}.
\end{displaymath}

MGS 一步：

\begin{displaymath}
w=Av_j,
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
h_{ij}=\langle v_i,w\rangle, \qquad w\leftarrow w-h_{ij}v_i,\quad i=0,\ldots,j,
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
h_{j+1,j}=\| w\|, \qquad v_{j+1}=w/h_{j+1,j}.
\end{displaymath}

\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.7: right-preconditioned FGMRES(m)
Input: A, b, x0, varying preconditioner M_j^-1, tolerance tau
r0 = b - A x0
beta = ||r0||
if beta == 0: return x0
v0 = r0/beta
g = (beta,0,...,0)^T

for j = 0,1,...,m-1:
    z_j = M_j^-1 v_j
    w = A z_j
    for i = 0,...,j:
        H[i,j] = <v_i,w>
        w = w - H[i,j] v_i
    H[j+1,j] = ||w||
    if H[j+1,j] != 0:
        v_{j+1} = w/H[j+1,j]
    apply_previous_givens(H[:,j])
    choose_givens(H[j,j],H[j+1,j])
    update_givens_rhs(g)
    if |g[j+1]| <= restart_tol:
        break

y = solve_upper_triangular(H[0:j,0:j],g[0:j])
x = x0 + sum_i y_i z_i
r_true = b - A x
if true_residual_gate(r_true): return x
else restart with r_true
\end{Verbatim}
若 \pycode{M\_j} 变化，必须保存 \pycode{z\_j}。不能用普通 GMRES 只保存 \pycode{v\_j} 后按固定线性预条件器累加。

\subsection{D.5.7 GCR}
预条件 GCR 的方向同时满足对 residual 的 \pycode{A}-inner-product 正交关系。简化算法：

\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.8: preconditioned GCR
r = b - A x
for k = 0,1,...:
    z = M^-1 r
    v = A z
    for i = 0,...,k-1:
        beta_i = <v,v_i>/<v_i,v_i>
        z = z - beta_i z_i
        v = v - beta_i v_i
    denom = <v,v>
    if denom <= floor: BREAKDOWN
    alpha = <r,v>/denom
    x = x + alpha z
    r = r - alpha v
    z_k = z
    v_k = v
    if true_residual_gate(r): return x
\end{Verbatim}
历史 memory 随方向数增长，需 restart 或 block 化。

\subsection{D.5.8 CA-CG 与 CA-GCR}
通信规避思想是以 \pycode{s} 步 Krylov basis

\begin{displaymath}
\mathcal B_s(A,r)=\{r,Ar,\ldots,A^sr\}
\end{displaymath}

一次形成多个方向，再通过 block inner product 和小系统求解更新：

\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.9: s-step CA-CG/CA-GCR skeleton
Input: A, r, block size s
1. form B_k = [r, A r, ..., A^s r]
2. local block orthogonalization / QR: B_k = Q_k R_k
3. compute all required block inner products in one reduction
4. solve small s x s least-squares/Hessenberg system
5. update x and r with Q_k coefficients
6. reliable-update full residual
7. reset Q_k when block conditioning or residual drift exceeds gate
\end{Verbatim}
优点是一次 global sync 摊销多个方向；风险是局部 block 条件数、失正交和 reduced precision。CA-GCR 不是无条件快路径。

\subsection{D.5.9 Lanczos 与 thick restart}
Hermitian \pycode{H} 上的 Lanczos：

\begin{displaymath}
Hq_j=\beta_{j-1}q_{j-1}+\alpha_jq_j+\beta_jq_{j+1}.
\end{displaymath}

三对角矩阵 \pycode{T\_m} 的特征值给出 Ritz 值，Ritz vector 为

\begin{displaymath}
y^{(i)}=Q_my_i.
\end{displaymath}

Ritz true residual 为

\begin{displaymath}
r_i=Hy^{(i)}-\theta_iy^{(i)}.
\end{displaymath}

thick restart 时保留若干个 Ritz vectors，把新起始向量与其正交化，再继续 Lanczos。验收必须同时报告 \pycode{||r\_i||}，不能只报告 Ritz 值。

\section{D.6 平滑器与局部预条件}
\subsection{D.6.1 Richardson}
\begin{displaymath}
x_{k+1}=x_k+\omega(b-Ax_k), \qquad r_{k+1}=r_k-\omega Ar_k.
\end{displaymath}

误差传播矩阵为

\begin{displaymath}
E_\omega=I-\omega A.
\end{displaymath}

稳定条件由 \pycode{A} 的谱决定。\pycode{omega} 过大或谱估计错误会放大误差。

\subsection{D.6.2 MR 平滑}
Strict CUDA MR 先令 \pycode{v=A r}，再在方向 \pycode{r} 上最小化：

\begin{displaymath}
\alpha_k= \frac{\langle v_k,r_k\rangle} {\langle v_k,v_k\rangle},
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
x_{k+1}=x_k+\alpha_kr_k, \qquad r_{k+1}=r_k-\alpha_kv_k.
\end{displaymath}

Python 通用 MR 采用：

\begin{displaymath}
p_k=A^\dagger r_k, \qquad v_k=Ap_k,
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
\alpha_k=\omega_k \frac{\langle p_k,p_k\rangle} {\langle v_k,v_k\rangle},
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
x_{k+1}=x_k+\alpha_kp_k, \qquad r_{k+1}=r_k-\alpha_kv_k.
\end{displaymath}

\pycode{omega<=1} 是非负阻尼因子。若分母接近零，两条路径均把步长退化为零或显式报告 breakdown，禁止写入 NaN。

\subsection{D.6.3 Chebyshev}
给定谱区间 \pycode{[lambda\_min,lambda\_max]}，令

\begin{displaymath}
\theta=\frac{\lambda_{\max}+\lambda_{\min}}2, \qquad \delta=\frac{\lambda_{\max}-\lambda_{\min}}2.
\end{displaymath}

当前 CUDA smoother 的递推为

\begin{displaymath}
\alpha_0=\frac1\theta, \qquad \beta_0=0,
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
p_k^{(new)}=\alpha_kr_k+\beta_kp_k,
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
x_k^{(new)}=x_k+p_k^{(new)}, \qquad r_k^{(new)}=r_k-Ap_k^{(new)}.
\end{displaymath}

下一组系数为

\begin{displaymath}
\beta_{k+1}=\left(\frac{\delta\alpha_k}{2}\right)^2, \qquad \alpha_{k+1}=\frac1{\theta-\beta_{k+1}}.
\end{displaymath}

历史 CUDA MG 路径采用保守估计

\begin{displaymath}
\hat\rho=\frac{\| Ar\|}{\| r\|}, \qquad \lambda_{\max}=8\hat\rho, \qquad \lambda_{\min}=0.05\lambda_{\max},
\end{displaymath}

若递推分母非正或系数非有限，源码回退到 damped Richardson 系数 \pycode{alpha=0.8/lambda\_max}、\pycode{beta=0}。这不是严格谱包络证明；谱估计错误会导致过度放大或无效平滑。源码锚点为 \pycode{cpp/cuda/qcu/include/lattice\_clover\_multigrid.h} 的 \pycode{chebyshev\_bounds}、\pycode{mg\_cheb\_update\_p\_x} 和 \pycode{mg\_cheb\_update\_r}。

\subsection{D.6.4 加性 Schwarz}
把格点划分为子域 \pycode{Omega\_i}，加性 Schwarz 预条件为

\begin{displaymath}
M^{-1}= \sum_iR_i^TA_i^{-1}R_i.
\end{displaymath}

乘性 Schwarz 按子域顺序复合

\begin{displaymath}
M^{-1}= I-\prod_i(I-R_i^TA_i^{-1}R_iA).
\end{displaymath}

子域越小，局部求解越便宜，但跨子域耦合越强。重叠越大，平滑质量通常越好，但通信和存储增加。

\subsection{D.6.5 SAP}
SAP 在 even、odd 或颜色子域之间交替：

\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.10: two-color SAP smoother
Input: A, b, x
r = b - A x
for color c in {0,1}:
    restrict r and A to subdomain c
    solve local subdomain system approximately
    prolong correction to full field
    update x
    recompute r
return x
\end{Verbatim}
SAP 更适合最近邻算子和 rank halo；跨 aggregate 耦合仍由 coarse space 处理。

\subsection{D.6.6 Smoother 的验收量}
对 smoother \pycode{S}，每次应用应记录

\begin{displaymath}
\rho_S= \frac{\| S r\|}{\| r\|},
\end{displaymath}

并按 Fourier 或实验高频模检查误差传播。平滑次数太少残留高频，太多会把细层 matvec 成本耗尽。

\section{D.7 MultiGrid 完整算法}
\subsection{D.7.1 Null-space basis}
在每个 aggregate \pycode{A\_X} 内拼接候选向量

\begin{displaymath}
V_X=[v_1,\ldots,v_{n_v}].
\end{displaymath}

目标条件是

\begin{displaymath}
V_X^\dagger V_X=I_E, \qquad \epsilon_{\mathrm{orth}}= \max_X\| V_X^\dagger V_X-I_E\|.
\end{displaymath}

\subsection{D.7.2 P/R}
\begin{displaymath}
(P\phi)(x)=V_X(x)\phi_c(X),
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
(R\psi)(X)= \sum_{x\in A_X}V_X(x)^\dagger\psi(x), \qquad R=P^\dagger.
\end{displaymath}

因此

\begin{displaymath}
P^\dagger P=I_{\mathrm{coarse}}, \qquad PP^\dagger\ne I_{\mathrm{fine}}
\end{displaymath} 一般成立。

\subsection{D.7.3 Galerkin}
raw 路径：

\begin{displaymath}
D_{l+1}=R_lD_lP_l.
\end{displaymath}

Strict PC 路径：

\begin{displaymath}
D_{l+1}=R_lX_l^{-1}D_lP_l.
\end{displaymath}

若 coarse stencil 只支持 onsite 和一跳：

\begin{displaymath}
D_{l+1} =X_{l+1} +\sum_\mu \left( Y_{l+1,\mu}^fT_{+\mu} +Y_{l+1,\mu}^bT_{-\mu} \right).
\end{displaymath}

\pycode{T\_mu} 为 coarse 格点上的周期平移。

\subsection{D.7.4 V-cycle}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.11: recursive V-cycle
Vcycle(level, b_l, x_l):
    if level == coarsest:
        return coarse_solver(A_l, b_l, x_l)

    x_l = smoother_pre(A_l, b_l, x_l, nu_pre)
    r_l = b_l - A_l x_l
    b_{l+1} = R_l r_l
    e_{l+1} = Vcycle(level+1, b_{l+1}, 0)
    x_l = x_l + P_l e_{l+1}
    x_l = smoother_post(A_l, b_l, x_l, nu_post)
    return x_l
\end{Verbatim}
外层的右预条件版本只把 \pycode{Vcycle} 当作 \pycode{M\textasciicircum{}-1}。

\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.12: right-preconditioned FGMRES + MG
x = x0
r = b - A x
for restart_cycle = 0,1,...:
    beta = ||r||
    if beta == 0: return x
    v0 = r/beta
    for j = 0,...,m-1:
        z_j = Vcycle(level=0, rhs=v_j, x=0)
        w = A z_j
        for i = 0,...,j:
            H_ij = <v_i,w>
            w = w - H_ij v_i
        H_{j+1,j} = ||w||
        if H_{j+1,j} != 0:
            v_{j+1} = w/H_{j+1,j}
        Givens_QR(H,g)
        if estimated_residual <= tau:
            break
    y = back_solve(H,g)
    x = x + sum_j z_j y_j
    r = b - A x
    if full_true_residual_gate(r):
        return x
\end{Verbatim}
\subsection{D.7.5 W/F/K-cycle}
设 \pycode{C\_l} 表示第 \pycode{l} 层 child solve，\pycode{V} 表示一次 child call，\pycode{F} 表示第一次 F、第二次 V，\pycode{K} 表示用固定小 FGMRES 包裹递归预条件器。

\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
V-cycle: child called once
W-cycle: child called twice
F-cycle: first recursive call uses F, second uses V
K-cycle: solve child equation by m-step FGMRES
\end{Verbatim}
K-cycle 的抽象递推为

\begin{displaymath}
x_{l+1}^{(m)}=\mathrm{FGMRES}_m(A_{l+1},b_{l+1};M_{l+1}^{-1}).
\end{displaymath}

能力边界：

\begin{center}\small
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{2pt}
\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.300\textwidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.300\textwidth}@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{路径} & \textbf{当前实现范围} \\
\midrule\endhead
Strict persistent hierarchy & 正式路径使用递归 V-cycle \\
legacy CUDA Clover MG & \pycode{\_MG\_USE\_GCR\_} mode bits 可选择 W/F/K-cycle \\
K-cycle & legacy 路径固定短 FGMRES，当前代码中 \pycode{m=2} \\
\bottomrule\end{longtable}
\end{center}
不能因为 \pycode{params[\_MG\_USE\_GCR\_]} 定义了 W/F/K bit，就声称 Strict persistent hierarchy 已经启用这些 cycle。Strict 当前源码中的递归函数是 V-cycle；legacy \pycode{lattice\_clover\_multigrid.h} 才包含显式 W/F/K 分派。

源码锚点：

\begin{center}\small
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{2pt}
\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.300\textwidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.300\textwidth}@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{功能} & \textbf{文件} \\
\midrule\endhead
Strict 持久 V-cycle & \pycode{cpp/cuda/qcu/src/apply\_multigrid\_strict.cu} \\
legacy W/F/K & \pycode{cpp/cuda/qcu/include/lattice\_clover\_multigrid.h} \\
mode bits & \pycode{pyqcu/cuda/define.py}、\pycode{cpp/cuda/qcu/include/define.h} \\
\bottomrule\end{longtable}
\end{center}
\subsection{D.7.6 33 点 legacy/compact stencil}
对 Schur operator，两次 hopping 可产生

\begin{center}\small
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{2pt}
\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.300\textwidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.300\textwidth}@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{位移类别} & \textbf{数量} \\
\midrule\endhead
onsite & 1 \\
同轴 \pycode{±mu} & 8 \\
双轴 \pycode{±mu±nu} & 24 \\
总计 & 33 \\
\bottomrule\end{longtable}
\end{center}
算子写为

\begin{displaymath}
(A x)(X) =S(X)x(X) +\sum_{\mu}\left[ H_{\mu}^{f}(X)x(X+\hat\mu) +H_{\mu}^{b}(X-\hat\mu)^\dagger x(X-\hat\mu) \right] +\sum_{\mu<\nu}\sum_{s_\mu,s_\nu\in\{-1,1\}} D_{\mu\nu}^{s_\mu s_\nu}(X)x(X+s_\mu\hat\mu+s_\nu\hat\nu).
\end{displaymath}

33 是支持位置数；每个位置承载 \pycode{E x E} dense block。

\subsection{D.7.7 Strict \pycode{X/Y/Yhat}}
构造：

\begin{displaymath}
X_C(X)=\sum_{x\in A_X}V_X^\dagger C(x)V_X,
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
Y_\mu^f(X) =-\kappa\sum_{x\in A_X} (AV_X(x))^\dagger U_\mu(x)V_{X+\hat\mu}(x+\hat\mu),
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
Y_\mu^b(X-\hat\mu) =-\kappa\sum_{x\in A_X} V_X^\dagger U_\mu^\dagger(x-\hat\mu) AV_{X-\hat\mu}(x-\hat\mu).
\end{displaymath}

raw action：

\begin{displaymath}
(D_cz)(X) =X(X)z(X) +\sum_\mu\left[ Y_\mu^f(X)z(X+\hat\mu) +Y_\mu^b(X-\hat\mu)^\dagger z(X-\hat\mu) \right].
\end{displaymath}

precondition：

\begin{displaymath}
\widehat Y_\mu^f(X)=X^{-1}(X)Y_\mu^f(X),
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
\widehat Y_\mu^b(q-\hat\mu) =Y_\mu^b(q-\hat\mu)X^{-\dagger}(q).
\end{displaymath}

\subsection{D.7.8 Strict coarse apply}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.13: strict preconditioned coarse hopping
Input:
  target point q
  target parity p_q
  input z on opposite parity p_in=1-p_q
  Yhat_f, Yhat_b storage

out(q) = 0
for mu = 0,...,3:
    out(q) += Yhat_f(q,mu) z(q+mu)
    out(q) += [Yhat_b(q-mu,mu)]^dagger z(q-mu)
return out(q)
\end{Verbatim}
这是对 target point 的权重读法。优化实现也可以对 source point 展开，但必须保持相同的 storage site、dagger 和 block multiplication order。

\subsection{D.7.9 Setup、colored probing 和缓存}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.14: distributed Galerkin setup
1. load global gauge/source/null slabs
2. build local periodic views
3. select non-conflicting source colors
4. batch fine operator probes
5. form Galerkin columns
6. check support is onsite + one hop
7. extract X and Yf/Yb
8. batch invert X
9. form Yhat_f=X^-1 Yf and Yhat_b=Yb X^-dagger
10. exchange required coarse/link halos
11. write one complete runtime-cache bundle
12. verify RP, orthogonality, inverse, support and true residual
\end{Verbatim}
colored batching的目的是一次探测多个互不冲突 source，降低 Python/C++ 调用、同步和峰值内存。它不改变最终 Galerkin 资产 identity。

\section{D.8 CUDA、MPI 与缓存算法}
\subsection{D.8.1 Wilson Dslash kernel}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.15: Wilson hopping kernel
Input: fermion_in, gauge links, neighbor indexes
for each site x:
    acc = 0
    for mu = 0..3:
        psi_f = fermion_in[x+mu]
        psi_b = fermion_in[x-mu]
        proj_f = spin_project_plus(psi_f, mu)
        proj_b = spin_project_minus(psi_b, mu)
        acc += color_multiply(U(x,mu), proj_f)
        acc += color_multiply(U^dagger(x-mu,mu), proj_b)
    fermion_out[x] = acc
\end{Verbatim}
实际内核使用 batch、向量化和 register tiling。\pycode{1-gamma\_mu} 与 \pycode{1+gamma\_mu} 的成对行关系可复用中间结果。

\subsection{D.8.2 Halo pack/exchange/unpack}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.16: blocking halo
pack face for each forward/backward direction
post receives
send faces
receive self/peer data
unpack into ghost slots
apply interior terms
apply boundary correction terms
\end{Verbatim}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.17: overlapped halo
record input-ready event on main stream
on exchange stream:
    wait event
    pack active faces
    stage H2D/D2H as required
    post MPI_Irecv/Isend
launch local base kernel on main stream
wait MPI requests
unpack/upload ghosts
record ghost-ready event
launch local tail/remote correction
\end{Verbatim}
active face 定义为当前 process grid 中 extent 大于 1 的方向和两个 side；未分解维度不发送。

\subsection{D.8.3 全局 inner product}
局部向量内积：

\begin{displaymath}
\ell=\sum_{x\in\Omega_r} \langle u(x),v(x)\rangle.
\end{displaymath}

全局结果为

\begin{displaymath}
g=\sum_{r=0}^{R-1}\ell_r.
\end{displaymath}

实现必须确保 kernel 消费的 device 标量与 host 记录值一致。\pycode{dot\_pair} 合并两个内积，\pycode{dot\_many} 将 Arnoldi 的多个系数放入一个大 Allreduce。

\subsection{D.8.4 分布式 FGMRES}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.18: distributed Arnoldi column
z_j = MG_precondition(v_j)
w = A z_j
local_coeff[i] = <v_i,w>
global_coeff = Allreduce(local_coeff)
w = w - sum_i global_coeff[i] v_i
beta = global_norm(w)
v_{j+1} = w/beta
update Hessenberg with global_coeff and beta
\end{Verbatim}
错误模式是 host \pycode{Hessenberg} 使用 global coeff，而 device orthogonalization 使用 rank-local coeff。必须在 Allreduce 后显式刷新 device coefficient。

\subsection{D.8.5 缓存写入}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.19: atomic strict runtime cache publish
1. canonicalize identity, metadata, stats and manifest JSON
2. compute suite SHA256 digests
3. create unique temporary file in destination directory
4. open one h5py File handle
5. write attrs state=writing
6. write each tensor in 8 MiB logical chunks
7. update per-tensor logical SHA256
8. write complete manifest and state=complete
9. flush and fsync file
10. atomically link temporary name to final identity path
11. if destination exists, verify identity; otherwise conflict
12. fsync directory
\end{Verbatim}
\subsection{D.8.6 缓存读取}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.20: strict runtime cache hit check
1. open read-only HDF5
2. verify root attribute set
3. verify state=complete
4. parse canonical identity/metadata/stats/manifest JSON
5. verify each JSON digest
6. verify schema and version
7. compare requested identity with cached identity
8. verify tensor manifest shape/dtype/nbytes
9. stream each tensor and recompute logical digest
10. H2D copy into requested device
11. return cache hit only after all checks
\end{Verbatim}
任何失败都标记为具体 cache miss reason，不静默使用部分文件。

\section{D.9 性能、误差与扩展性公式}
\subsection{D.9.1 Solve 速度和加速比}
正式性能比：

\begin{displaymath}
R=\frac{t_{\mathrm{QUDA,steady}}}{t_{\mathrm{PyQCU,steady}}}.
\end{displaymath}

若比较 PyQCU 两个版本：

\begin{displaymath}
S_{\mathrm{PyQCU}}=\frac{t_{\mathrm{old}}}{t_{\mathrm{new}}}.
\end{displaymath}

若比较 PyQCU 相对 QUDA 的加速倍率：

\begin{displaymath}
S_{\mathrm{PyQCU/QUDA}} =\frac{t_{\mathrm{QUDA}}}{t_{\mathrm{PyQCU}}} =R.
\end{displaymath}

\subsection{D.9.2 True residual}
\begin{displaymath}
r=b-Dx, \qquad \rho_{\mathrm{rel}}= \frac{\| r\|_2}{\| b\|_2}.
\end{displaymath}

当前正式门：

\begin{displaymath}
\rho_{\mathrm{rel}}<5\times10^{-6}.
\end{displaymath}

Arnoldi least-squares estimate、GCR iterated residual 和 Schur residual 不能替代该门。

\subsection{D.9.3 Strong scaling efficiency}
固定总问题，线程/rank 从 1 增至 \pycode{N}：

\begin{displaymath}
E_{\mathrm{strong}}(N) =\frac{T_1}{N\,T_N}.
\end{displaymath}

若基准不是 1，而是 \pycode{N0}，则

\begin{displaymath}
E(N_0,N) =\frac{N_0T_{N_0}}{N\,T_N}.
\end{displaymath}

\subsection{D.9.4 Weak scaling efficiency}
保持每 rank 工作量近似固定：

\begin{displaymath}
E_{\mathrm{weak}}(N) =\frac{T_1}{T_N}.
\end{displaymath}

若每个新增 rank 也增加格点体积，则必须同时报告局部体积、总问题和通信时间。

\subsection{D.9.5 MG break-even}
一次 MG 相比 1L direct Krylov 的收益条件：

\begin{displaymath}
T_{\mathrm{fine}}(N_{1L}-N_{\mathrm{MG}}) > N_V\left( T_R+T_{A_c}+T_P+T_{\mathrm{sync}} \right).
\end{displaymath}

左边是减少外层迭代节省的 fine matvec 时间，右边是每个 V-cycle 的 restriction、coarse apply、prolongation 和同步成本。该不等式不成立时，MG 即使减少迭代也可能更慢。

\subsection{D.9.6 显存模型}
对 coarse 自由度 \pycode{E}、coarse 体积 \pycode{V\_c}，dense onsite block 的内存近似为

\begin{displaymath}
M_X=O(V_cE^2).
\end{displaymath}

若每层保存 \pycode{X}、\pycode{X\textasciicircum{}-1}、raw \pycode{Y}、\pycode{Yhat}，至少还要乘以方向和资产份数：

\begin{displaymath}
M_{\mathrm{levels}} \sim M_V+M_X+M_{X^{-1}}+8M_Y+8M_{\hat Y}.
\end{displaymath}

实际峰值还包含 transfer、workspace、MPI staging、parent tensor 和 allocator cache。

\section{D.10 508 报告的物理公式、求解算法与优化}
\subsection{D.10.1 格点作用量与 propagator}
508 报告采用 Wilson kernel：

\begin{displaymath}
2\kappa M[U]_{x,y} = \delta_{xy} -\kappa\sum_\mu\left[ (1-\gamma_\mu)U_\mu(x)\delta_{x+\hat\mu,y} +(1+\gamma_\mu)U_\mu^\dagger(x-\hat\mu) \delta_{x-\hat\mu,y} \right].
\end{displaymath}

因此

\begin{displaymath}
M=D_W.
\end{displaymath}

\subsection{D.10.2 Clover 项}
\begin{displaymath}
\sigma_{\mu\nu}F_{\mu\nu} = 2\gamma_\mu\gamma_\nu \frac14\sum_P \frac12\left(U_P-U_P^\dagger\right).
\end{displaymath}

\subsection{D.10.3 Quasi-PDF 与两点函数}
\begin{displaymath}
\widetilde f(x,P_z,1/a) = \int\frac{dz}{4\pi} e^{ixzP_z} \left\langle P| \bar\psi(z)\gamma_tU(z,0)\psi(0) |P\right\rangle.
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
C_2(t,t_0) = \left\langle \bar\psi(x,t)\Gamma\psi(x,t) \bar\psi(y,t_0)\Gamma'\psi(y,t_0) \right\rangle.
\end{displaymath}

Wick 收缩的代表项：

\begin{displaymath}
C_2(t,t_0) =-\gamma_5S_q(x,y)\gamma_5S_q(y,x), \qquad S_q=D_q^{-1}.
\end{displaymath}

\subsection{D.10.4 Even-odd Schur}
508 报告使用：

\begin{displaymath}
A'_{oo}=A_{oo}-\kappa^2D_{oe}A_{ee}^{-1}D_{eo},
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
b'_o=b_o+\kappa D_{oe}A_{ee}^{-1}b_e.
\end{displaymath}

求解：

\begin{displaymath}
A'_{oo}x_o=b'_o,
\end{displaymath}

重建：

\begin{displaymath}
x_e=A_{ee}^{-1}(b_e+\kappa D_{eo}x_o).
\end{displaymath}

这相当于当前通用 Schur 公式在特定符号和 kappa 归一化下的写法。

\subsection{D.10.5 CG 伪代码}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.21: CG used by the historical DCU implementation
x = x0
r = b - A x
p = r
rho = <r,r>
for k = 1..max_iter:
    if sqrt(rho) <= tolerance:
        break
    Ap = A p
    denom = <p,Ap>
    if denom == 0 or nonfinite: BREAKDOWN
    alpha = rho/denom
    x = x + alpha p
    r = r - alpha Ap
    rho_new = <r,r>
    beta = rho_new/rho
    p = r + beta p
    rho = rho_new
\end{Verbatim}
\subsection{D.10.6 BiCGStab 伪代码}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.22: historical BiCGStab
x = x0
r = b - A x
r_hat = r
p = 0; v = 0
rho_old = alpha = omega = 1
for k = 1..max_iter:
    rho = <r_hat,r>
    if rho == 0 or nonfinite: BREAKDOWN
    beta = (rho/rho_old)*(alpha/omega)
    p = r + beta*(p - omega*v)
    v = A p
    denom = <r_hat,v>
    if denom == 0 or nonfinite: BREAKDOWN
    alpha = rho/denom
    s = r - alpha v
    x = x + alpha p
    if ||s|| <= tolerance:
        break
    t = A s
    tt = <t,t>
    if tt == 0 or nonfinite: BREAKDOWN
    omega = <t,s>/tt
    x = x + omega s
    r = s - omega t
    rho_old = rho
\end{Verbatim}
历史实现还需对 \pycode{rho}、\pycode{omega} 和残差进行 finite guard，并周期性重算 full residual。

\subsection{D.10.7 四项核心优化}
\begin{center}\small
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{2pt}
\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.300\textwidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.300\textwidth}@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{优化} & \textbf{原理} \\
\midrule\endhead
Gamma 行复用 & \pycode{1±gamma\_mu} 的行对关系允许重用中间结果，减少相关计算 \\
SU(3) 重构 & 只读取三行，利用正交和共轭关系构造另外三行，以计算换访存 \\
Even-odd & 求解半体积 Schur 系统，降低问题规模和 Krylov 迭代 \\
合并访存 & 将时空维放最后、spin-color 连续，使线程访问连续地址 \\
\bottomrule\end{longtable}
\end{center}
\subsection{D.10.8 \pycode{give\_clover} 性能模型}
单点内存和浮点量历史估计：

\begin{displaymath}
B_{\mathrm{sp}}=1344\ \mathrm{B},\qquad F_{\mathrm{sp}}=1152\ \mathrm{FLOPs},
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
B_{\mathrm{dp}}=2688\ \mathrm{B},\qquad F_{\mathrm{dp}}=1152\ \mathrm{FLOPs}.
\end{displaymath}

报告使用

\begin{displaymath}
T=\frac{M}{E}+\frac{F}{F_p}+T_0
\end{displaymath}

拟合得到

\begin{displaymath}
E\approx424.258\ \mathrm{GiB/s}, \qquad F_p\approx1.533\ \mathrm{TFLOP/s}.
\end{displaymath}

该拟合未给出误差条，也未明确单卡/单节点/全系统的归一化。因此只能作为平台诊断，不是硬件峰值测量。

\subsection{D.10.9 强扩展和弱扩展重算}
若以 \pycode{N0} 进程为基准，强扩展效率为

\begin{displaymath}
E_{\mathrm{strong}}(N_0,N) = \frac{N_0T_{N_0}}{N\,T_N}.
\end{displaymath}

以原始耗时重算的历史趋势大致为：

\begin{center}\small
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{2pt}
\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.230\textwidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.230\textwidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.230\textwidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.230\textwidth}@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{测试} & \textbf{路径} & \textbf{低并发} & \textbf{高并发} \\
\midrule\endhead
TEST6 c64 & Wilson & np2 约 96.5\% & np64 约 8.6\% \\
TEST6 c64 & Clover & np2 约 95.0\% & np16 约 62.0\% \\
TEST8 c64 & Wilson & np512 约 61.5\% & np1024 约 20.8\% \\
TEST8 c64 & Clover & np1024 & 约 51.4\% \\
TEST9 c128 & Wilson & np1024 & 约 28.5\% \\
TEST9 c128 & Clover & np1024 & 约 60.7\% \\

\end{center}

\setlength{\tabcolsep}{2pt}
\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.230\textwidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.230\textwidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.230\textwidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.230\textwidth}@{}}

因此正确结论是“小规模低并发较好，高并发时 Wilson 路径明显衰减，Clover 路径相对平缓”，而不是笼统“扩展性良好”。

\section{D.11 其他格点费米子作用量的对照公式}
这些作用量在当前文档中用于理论边界和 QUDA 对照。除 Wilson/Clover 外，不应把它们写成 PyQCU 已完整支持的生产 API。

\subsection{D.11.1 Twisted-mass}
简并双重态：

\begin{displaymath}
D_{\mathrm{tm}} =D_W(m_0)+i\mu\gamma_5\tau_3.
\end{displaymath}

非简并双重态：

\begin{displaymath}
D_{\mathrm{nd}} =D_W(m_0) +i\mu_\sigma\gamma_5\tau_1 +\mu_\delta\tau_3.
\end{displaymath}

\pycode{tau\_i} 作用于 flavor 空间。Even-odd block 必须把 flavor-spin onsite 结构放入 \pycode{A\_e}、\pycode{A\_o}。QUDA 参考入口包括 \pycode{dirac\_twisted\_mass.cpp} 和 \pycode{dslash\_ndeg\_twisted\_mass.cpp}。

\subsection{D.11.2 Twisted-clover}
\begin{displaymath}
D_{\mathrm{tmC}} =D_W+C_{\mathrm{SW}} +i\mu\gamma_5\tau_3.
\end{displaymath}

Clover 与 twist 都是 onsite 项，粗化时应共同进入 \pycode{X\_c}，不能再把它们当作 hopping 重复加入。

\subsection{D.11.3 Staggered}
相位为

\begin{displaymath}
\eta_\mu(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{\nu<\mu}x_\nu}.
\end{displaymath}

无质量 staggered operator：

\begin{displaymath}
(D_{\mathrm{stag}}\chi)(x) = \frac12\sum_\mu\eta_\mu(x) \left[ U_\mu(x)\chi(x+\hat\mu) -U_\mu^\dagger(x-\hat\mu)\chi(x-\hat\mu) \right].
\end{displaymath}

asqtad/HISQ 通过 Fat7、Lepage、Naik 等路径扩展 support。宽 stencil 不能直接塞进只接受最近邻 \pycode{X/Y} 的 Strict ABI。

\subsection{D.11.4 Domain-wall 与 Möbius}
Domain-wall 的第五维示意矩阵为

\begin{displaymath}
\begin{aligned} D_{5d}(s,s') ={}&D_W^+(s)\delta_{s,s'} -P_-\delta_{s+1,s'} -P_+\delta_{s-1,s'}\\ &+m_f\left( P_-\delta_{s,0}\delta_{s',L_s-1} +P_+\delta_{s,L_s-1}\delta_{s',0} \right), \end{aligned}
\end{displaymath}

其中

\begin{displaymath}
P_\pm=\frac{1\pm\gamma_5}{2}.
\end{displaymath}

有限 \pycode{L\_s} 产生 residual mass。Möbius 通过第五维系数重参数化，改善 sign-function 逼近效率。第五维会改变站点自由度和 halo 结构。

\subsection{D.11.5 Overlap}
\begin{displaymath}
D_{\mathrm{ov}}(m) = \left(1-\frac{am}{2\rho}\right)D_{\mathrm{ov}}(0)+am,
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
D_{\mathrm{ov}}(0) =\rho\left[1+\gamma_5\mathrm{sign}(H_W)\right], \qquad H_W=\gamma_5(D_W-\rho).
\end{displaymath}

\pycode{sign(H\_W)} 常用 rational approximation 或 polynomial 近似，每次应用可能包含多次 kernel solve。它不是当前 Wilson/Clover Dslash 的同一成本模型。

\subsection{D.11.6 作用量对照}
\begin{center}\small
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{2pt}
\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.230\textwidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.230\textwidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.230\textwidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.230\textwidth}@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{Action} & \textbf{自由度/support} & \textbf{主要数值难点} & \textbf{当前状态} \\
\midrule\endhead
Wilson & spin-color、最近邻 & 轻质量条件数、加性质量重整化 & PyQCU 实现 \\
Clover & Wilson 加 onsite block & 局部 inverse、非平凡 Schur & PyQCU 实现 \\
Twisted-mass & flavor-spin onsite & flavor block、dagger 约定 & QUDA 参考 \\
Twisted-clover & Clover 加 twist & 更大 onsite block、非 Hermitian & QUDA 参考 \\
Staggered & 单分量、phase stencil & taste、rooting 语义 & QUDA 参考 \\
asqtad/HISQ & 宽 stencil & 多路径通信、宽 support & QUDA 参考 \\
Domain-wall & 第五维局部耦合 & \pycode{L\_s} 成本、残余质量 & QUDA 参考 \\
Möbius & 五维重参数化 & 第五维谱逼近 & QUDA 参考 \\
Overlap & sign function 非局部近似 & 多层嵌套求解 & 理论参考 \\
\bottomrule\end{longtable}
\end{center}
\section{D.12 端到端可审计求解算法}
\subsection{D.12.1 输入和不变量}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.23: auditable solve input validation
Input:
  U_mu(x), rhs b, mass/kappa, lattice, boundary, dtype, layout

1. verify all lattice dimensions and MPI grid are positive
2. verify spacing axes are the final four trailing axes
3. verify gauge color axes are 3x3
4. verify dtype and precision match params
5. verify SU(3) links:
      max_x |det U_mu(x)-1| << 1
      max_x ||U_mu(x)^dagger U_mu(x)-I|| << 1
6. verify source normalization and boundary conditions
7. verify compiler binary architecture and cache identity
8. fail closed before allocating runtime scratch if any check fails
\end{Verbatim}
\subsection{D.12.2 算子准备}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.24: operator preparation
1. build periodic neighbor table
2. load/construct gauge halo
3. construct Wilson hopping H
4. if Clover enabled:
       build plaquette/Clover field
       build T_p and A_p
       batch-invert A_p
5. partition even/odd parity
6. verify operator identities:
       D^dagger = gamma5 D gamma5
       parity round trip
       Schur reconstruction
7. verify free-field and c_sw=0 limits
\end{Verbatim}
\subsection{D.12.3 Full solve}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.25: full periodic Wilson/Clover solve
1. choose x0 (zero or warm)
2. compute r0 = b - D x0
3. if ||b|| == 0 return x=0
4. choose solver:
       BiCGStab for general D
       FGMRES for varying preconditioner
       CG only for SPD D^dagger D or Hermitian operator
5. precondition:
       plain = identity
       Schur/MATPC = parity block solve
       MG = V/W/F/K hierarchy
6. iterate until estimate reaches tolerance
7. periodically recompute r_true = b - D x
8. if true residual gate fails:
       reset recurrence or restart Krylov
9. return x, full true residual, iteration ledger, phase times
\end{Verbatim}
\subsection{D.12.4 Strict MG setup solve}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.26: strict MG setup and solve
1. load canonical gauge, rhs and full near-null vectors
2. validate block/aggregate geometry and checkerboard parity
3. construct local orthogonal V
4. distribute rank slices and exchange setup halos
5. compute strict D_c = R X^-1 D P
6. extract X, Yf, Yb; fail on wider support
7. batch invert X
8. form Yhat_f=X^-1 Yf, Yhat_b=Yb X^-dagger
9. persist one immutable runtime cache bundle
10. initialize persistent hierarchy and dot/FGMRES workspaces
11. run right-preconditioned FGMRES
12. each Arnoldi column calls one recursive V-cycle
13. use global dot, dot pair and dot many in distributed mode
14. at each restart compute full true residual
15. stop only when full true residual passes
16. close hierarchy and release streams/HDF5/pointers
\end{Verbatim}
\subsection{D.12.5 资源回收}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.27: deterministic teardown
1. finish final true-residual and status record
2. stop new kernels and MPI collectives
3. call strict end on hierarchy
4. release coarse assets, null vectors and scratch
5. close HDF5 handles
6. release per-thread stream and device context state
7. clear set_ptrs handles
8. check live allocation baseline and set-index state
\end{Verbatim}
\subsection{D.12.6 可复现运行记录}
\begin{Verbatim}[breaklines=true,breakanywhere=true,fontsize=\scriptsize]
Algorithm D.28: evidence bundle completion
1. save commit/tag and dirty status
2. save source and binary SHA256
3. save requested/actual CUDA architecture
4. save gauge/source/null identity and bundle hash
5. save MPI grid, rank-device map and thread count
6. save cold, warmup, steady raw timings
7. save iteration and full true residual per sample
8. save phase/level timing and device memory
9. save error codes and substitutions
10. only then mark fair=true
\end{Verbatim}
该附录保留了当前文档中公认可复用的公式、递推和算法骨架。若源码 convention、容差、storage site 或 parallel reduction order 变化，相关公式必须重新逐项核对，而不是仅更新结论数字。

\section{D.13 算子等价、Galerkin 与残差审计公式}
\subsection{D.13.1 算子等价}
对两个实现 \pycode{A1}、\pycode{A2} 和测试向量 \pycode{v}，定义

\begin{displaymath}
\epsilon_{\mathrm{op}}(v) = \frac{\| A_1v-A_2v\|_2} {\max(\| A_1v\|_2,\| A_2v\|_2,\epsilon_{\mathrm{floor}})}.
\end{displaymath}

该检查至少覆盖：

\begin{enumerate}
\item Python 与 C++ Wilson/Clover；

\item full 与 Schur reconstruct；

\item raw \pycode{X/Y} 与 preconditioned \pycode{Yhat}；

\item 单 rank 与多 rank halo；

\item 不同 dtype 和不同 process grid。

\end{enumerate}
\subsection{D.13.2 Transfer 伴随关系}
对任意 coarse \pycode{z} 和 fine \pycode{f}，应满足

\begin{displaymath}
\langle Pz,f\rangle = \langle z,Rf\rangle, \qquad R=P^\dagger.
\end{displaymath}

数值指标：

\begin{displaymath}
\epsilon_{PR} = \frac{ \left|\langle Pz,f\rangle-\langle z,Rf\rangle\right| }{ \max(1, |\langle Pz,f\rangle|, |\langle z,Rf\rangle|) }.
\end{displaymath}

\subsection{D.13.3 Schur 等价}
令 \pycode{E} 为 prepare 映射、\pycode{J} 为 reconstruct 映射、\pycode{S} 为 compact operator，要求

\begin{displaymath}
S=EDJ, \qquad DJy=\widetilde J Sy.
\end{displaymath}

数值检查：

\begin{displaymath}
\epsilon_{\mathrm{Schur}} = \frac{\| E(DJy)-Sy\|_2} {\max(\| Sy\|_2,\epsilon_{\mathrm{floor}})}.
\end{displaymath}

同时必须用 reconstruct 后的 full residual 验证。

\subsection{D.13.4 Galerkin 与 support}
\begin{displaymath}
y_1=(RA_fP)v_c, \qquad y_2=A_cv_c.
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
\epsilon_{\mathrm{Galerkin}} = \frac{\| y_1-y_2\|_2} {\max(\| y_1\|_2,\| y_2\|_2,\epsilon_{\mathrm{floor}})}.
\end{displaymath}

若 \pycode{A\_c} 是最近邻截断：

\begin{displaymath}
\epsilon_{\mathrm{support}} = \frac{\|(RA_fP-A_c)v\|_2} {\max(\| RA_fPv\|_2,\epsilon_{\mathrm{floor}})}.
\end{displaymath}

对 Strict ABI，\pycode{epsilon\_support} 不是可容忍数值误差。只要出现超一跳模型项，必须 fail-closed。

\subsection{D.13.5 预条件器质量}
对 residual \pycode{r} 和 correction \pycode{z=M\textasciicircum{}-1r}：

\begin{displaymath}
q_M=\frac{\| r-Az\|_2}{\| r\|_2}.
\end{displaymath}

\pycode{q\_M} 小表示单次预条件强，但必须同时报告 V-cycle 成本。一个强而昂贵的预条件器可能使总 solve 更慢。

\subsection{D.13.6 Backward error}
若 \pycode{||A||} 可估计，则

\begin{displaymath}
\eta(x)= \frac{\| b-Ax\|_2} {\| A\|_2\| x\|_2+\| b\|_2}.
\end{displaymath}

报告中写 “tolerance = 1e-8” 时必须说明是 absolute、relative、backward error、Arnoldi estimate 还是 full true residual。

\subsection{D.13.7 Krylov 多项式视角}
固定预条件器时

\begin{displaymath}
e_k=p_k(M^{-1}A)e_0, \qquad p_k(0)=1.
\end{displaymath}

SPD CG 的经典上界：

\begin{displaymath}
\frac{\| e_k\|_A}{\| e_0\|_A} \le 2\left( \frac{\sqrt{\kappa(A)}-1} {\sqrt{\kappa(A)}+1} \right)^k.
\end{displaymath}

该上界不直接适用于非正规、非 Hermitian、有限精度或变化预条件路径。

\subsection{D.13.8 粗空间对低模的覆盖}
投影算子

\begin{displaymath}
\Pi=P(RP)^{-1}R.
\end{displaymath}

覆盖误差：

\begin{displaymath}
\epsilon_{\mathrm{low}} = \max_{i\in I} \frac{\|(I-\Pi)u_i\|_2}{\| u_i\|_2}.
\end{displaymath}

选择 block/nvec 时至少同时扫描

\begin{displaymath}
(n_v,\text{block volume},E,\epsilon_{\mathrm{orth}},\epsilon_{\mathrm{low}}).
\end{displaymath}

\subsection{D.13.9 通信量模型}
对四维局部 lattice \pycode{Lx*Ly*Lz*Lt}，每个方向有两个 face。若每个 face 有 \pycode{n\_face} 个复元素，则一次最近邻 halo 的量级为

\begin{displaymath}
N_{\mathrm{halo}} \approx 2n_{\mathrm{face}} \left( L_yL_zL_t+L_xL_zL_t+L_xL_yL_t+L_xL_yL_z \right).
\end{displaymath}

Coarse \pycode{Y} 是 dense \pycode{E x E} block，因此通信字节数近似随 \pycode{E\textasciicircum{}2} 增长。

\subsection{D.13.10 显存顶层预算}
\begin{displaymath}
M_{\mathrm{peak}} \approx M_{\mathrm{fine}} +M_{\mathrm{null}} +M_{\mathrm{coarse}} +M_{\mathrm{workspace}} +M_{\mathrm{allocator}}.
\end{displaymath}

最后一项不是 live tensor。加载 cache 前后、setup、first solve、steady 和 close 后都应分别采样。

\subsection{D.13.11 谱分解与误差传播}
若 \pycode{A=VΛV\textasciicircum{}-1}，则

\begin{displaymath}
p(A)=Vp(\Lambda)V^{-1}.
\end{displaymath}

因此误差传播不仅由单个迭代多项式值决定，也由 \pycode{V} 的条件数控制。非正规矩阵中，即使所有特征值小于 1，短期 norm 仍可能增长。

\subsection{D.13.12 Cycle 的算子形式}
令 \pycode{C\_l\textasciicircum{}V/W/F} 表示第 \pycode{l} 层的 coarse correction，\pycode{S\_pre/post} 为平滑器：

\begin{displaymath}
C_\ell^V = S_{\mathrm{post}} P_\ell C_{\ell+1}^V R_\ell S_{\mathrm{pre}},
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
C_\ell^W = S_{\mathrm{post}} P_\ell C_{\ell+1}^W R_\ell P_\ell C_{\ell+1}^W R_\ell S_{\mathrm{pre}},
\end{displaymath}

\begin{displaymath}
C_\ell^F = S_{\mathrm{post}} P_\ell C_{\ell+1}^F R_\ell P_\ell C_{\ell+1}^V R_\ell S_{\mathrm{pre}}.
\end{displaymath}

W-cycle 在同一层调用两次 child，通常粗层成本更高。F-cycle 第一次 child 使用 F、第二次使用 V。K-cycle 使用短 FGMRES 包裹 child preconditioner。

\subsection{D.13.13 目标时间比较}
若一次 V-cycle 调用 \pycode{N\_R} 次 restriction、\pycode{N\_P} 次 prolongation、\pycode{N\_A} 次 coarse apply，则

\begin{displaymath}
T_{\mathrm{Vcycle}} \approx N_pT_{\mathrm{pre}} +N_RT_R +N_AT_{\mathrm{coarse}} +N_PT_P +N_qT_{\mathrm{post}} +T_{\mathrm{sync}}.
\end{displaymath}

外层总时间还要乘以有效预条件调用次数：

\begin{displaymath}
T_{\mathrm{solve}} \approx N_{\mathrm{outer}}T_{\mathrm{Vcycle}} +T_{\mathrm{fine\,matvec}} +T_{\mathrm{outer\,sync}} +T_{\mathrm{true\,residual}}.
\end{displaymath}

这解释了为什么“外层迭代数更少”不必然意味着总时间更短。
